cases.expected: Method returns without modifying the Zone; the internal RRset collection remains unchanged.
cases.description: The Zone does not contain an RRset for the name/type of the supplied Record, so findRRset returns null and the method exits early.
Calling removeRecord with a null argument should throw NullPointerException when the method attempts to invoke r.getName().
If the supplied Record returns null for getName(), findRRset is invoked with a null Name, which should result in a NullPointerException.

group: removeRecord - record not present in RRset (size > 1)

cases.description: The Zone contains an RRset for the Record's name/type with more than one entry, but the specific Record is not part of that RRset. Calling deleteRR on the RRset should throw NoSuchElementException.

group: removeRecord - record not present in RRset (size == 1)

cases.description: The Zone contains an RRset of size 1 for the Record's name/type, but the sole entry differs from the supplied Record. The method will fall into the else branch and invoke deleteRR, which should throw NoSuchElementException because the Record is absent.
